name: Whisker Litter-Robot 4
description: Whisker's self-cleaning, app-connected litter box for cats 3–25 lbs — laser- and weight-based automatic waste separation, per-cat weight tracking, and a customizable cleaning cycle, built around the company's SafeCat/Omnisense sensor system.

specs.label: Cat Weight Range
specs.note: up to 4 cats in one household

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: $7.99/mo or $79.90/yr; core app features (self-cleaning, weight-ID, alerts) are free

sourcing: Specs and pricing sourced from Whisker's official product page (whisker.com/litter-robot-4) and its Litter-Robot 4 vs. 5 comparison post, cross-checked against PetSmart and Best Buy retail listings, as of September 2026. The Litter-Robot 4 remains actively sold alongside the newer Litter-Robot 5 and 5 Pro, not discontinued. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: $699 MSRP, per whisker.com — matched at the same price on PetSmart and Best Buy. Whisker also sells the newer Litter-Robot 5 ($799) and Litter-Robot 5 Pro ($899) alongside it; the 4 has not been discontinued.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Litter-Robot 4 uses Whisker's SafeCat System with Omnisense Detection — lasers, weight sensors, and anti-obstruction technology — to prevent the cleaning cycle from running while a cat is inside or nearby. SmartScale logs each cat's weight to identify individual cats in multi-cat households. Note: it requires 2.4GHz WiFi specifically; Whisker's spec sheet states the 5GHz band is not supported.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: The Litter-Robot 4's SmartScale system weighs each cat at every visit, letting the companion app track and distinguish up to four individual cats sharing one unit by weight alone — a specific multi-cat identification capability most single-sensor automatic litter boxes lack. Whisker's own spec sheet also states the unit requires 2.4GHz Wi-Fi specifically, since the 5GHz band isn't supported.
